subcategory: unified retriever-generator MLLM with collaborative parametric knowledge calibration for KB-VQA
problem: Retriever and answer generator in retrieval-augmented KB-VQA are trained as separate modules with limited interaction, preventing bi-directional knowledge sharing.
architecture: UniRVQA: one MLLM (BLIP2 or InstructBLIP with Q-Former + Flan-T5-XL) serves as both retriever and generator; jointly trained on ColBERT-style late-interaction knowledge retrieval, retrieval-augmented answer generation and a reflective-answering task that teaches the model to judge its own knowledge boundary; DoRA fine-tuning.
retriever: late-interaction (ColBERT-style) retrieval with the shared MLLM encoder

datasets.name: OK-VQA
datasets.details: over 10k questions on MSCOCO images; Google Search Corpus of 166,389 passages

key_results: OK-VQA EM 66.79%, a 4.78% improvement over the best reported system.
InfoSeek accuracy 22.06 (all) vs 20.9 for CLIP + FiD and 20.4 for CLIP + PaLM.
Retrieval PRR@5: 68.51 on InfoSeek vs 59.60 for PreFLMR; 90.47 on OK-VQA vs 89.32 for FLMR.
Training takes about 3 GPU hours for 3,000 steps.
strengths: Single shared network for retrieval and generation reduces model size; ablations show joint calibration beats separate or sequential training.
Results averaged over 3 seeds; reflective answering improves EM.

limitations.text: InfoSeek experiments use a down-sampled subset.
Gains in OK-VQA retrieval over prior models are small (about 1%).

notes: Read from the arXiv copy (published version in Knowledge-Based Systems).
title: Enabling collaborative parametric knowledge calibration for retrieval-augmented Vision Question Answering
